mie - arm64-v8a build

built     : 2026-09-29T22:33:59
abi       : arm64-v8a
platform  : android-27
backend   : cpu, gpu, qnn, mtk, dla, qnnnative
optim     : release
tflite    : 2.18.0
ndk       : D:\path\to\android-ndk-r16b

layout:
  include/  public headers, add -Iinclude
  lib/      libmie.a, link it or list the .a directly
  bin/      mie_run plus the TFLite runtime .so it needs at runtime

Runtime note: mie_run needs libtensorflowlite_c.so and
libtensorflowlite_gpu_delegate.so on LD_LIBRARY_PATH. The Android linker does
NOT search the executable's own directory, so keep bin/ together and run:
  cd bin && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. [ADSP_LIBRARY_PATH=<skels>] ./mie_run model.tflite qnn

Integration note: libmie.a is built with APP_STL=c++_static. Link it
into an app built with APP_STL := c++_static as well - Config passes
std::string and std::vector across the API boundary, so mixing a
static and a shared libc++ would break it.
